creation_rule: An invalid-measurement tick with current released command minus resolved command anchor crossing the frozen material and response-open criteria creates deferred command demand but no fault evidence.
preservation_rule: Same-direction updates preserve first observable time; invalid rows never advance pairs or fault evidence.
cancellation_rule: If current net demand becomes nonmaterial before any valid unresolved non-response evidence, cancel deferred-only demand. Preserve prior valid watch/suspicion where present.
recovery_rule: First valid measurement reevaluates deferred demand without new command, using the first observable demand time for old age. Evaluate motion against preserved matched pair before any checkpoint update.
paired_references: Inherited R4 resolved-anchor and progress-checkpoint pairs remain atomic and separate; no recovery-only measurement baseline reset.
watch_timing: Invalid rows preserve causal demand age but do not earn non-response samples. Recovery does not reset the first observable timestamp or prior valid suspicion.
reversal_rule: During invalidity, update directional deferred context from current signed net demand; do not credit progress or clear valid prior suspicion; reevaluate current direction on valid recovery.
limitation: R41-7 mini-suite fails: a reversal during invalid measurement is logged as deferred bookkeeping but the pre-loss positive-direction epoch survives recovery, so the negative-direction stuck demand is never evaluated. Full R4 validation is prohibited. An exploratory C9R comparison also found inherited R4 anchor-timing differences; this is not a formal full regression result.
